items.title: The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.75%, the highest since Jan. 2025. When the yield rises above 4.77%, it will be the highest since 2007. However, in 2007 Treasuries were still in a bull market, with yields headed lower. Now they're in a bear market, with yields headed much higher.
items.content:

items.title: The Chicago PMI unexpectedly collapsed to 47.1 in August from 57.6 in July. Analysts had expected a rise to 59. This is the lowest reading since December 2025, but more significantly the biggest downside surprise since February 2015. The economy is far weaker than most believe.
